scope: Rechecks complete committed raw source/native captures without requiring ignored compiler/build work files. Recomputes chunk integrity, fail-closed NDJSON transport, strict selected-state schema, every ordered snapshot/event and both terminal report comparisons. This replays diagnostic evidence, not a new simulator execution or a throughput benchmark.

sourceSchema.scope: Supplemental JSON schema and integrity for typed-entry boundary traces; own enumerable string-keyed data fields only. No whole-program or battle semantic qualification.

nativeSchema.scope: Supplemental JSON schema and integrity for typed-entry boundary traces; own enumerable string-keyed data fields only. No whole-program or battle semantic qualification.

limitations: Not a whole-program graph: nested objects, prototype state, function code/closures, shared-object aliases outside selected roots and weak contents are omitted

Selected state includes only own enumerable string-keyed primitive fields, numeric vectors and selected ordered engine/unit/skill/buff lists; field names are encoded as entry data and cannot collide with snapshot reference tags
Own data-descriptor reads do not invoke ordinary getters; reflective inspection of an unknown Proxy can invoke traps and is outside the supported fixture domain
Payload object graphs are separately descriptor-encoded with numeric bits, accessor identities and per-payload aliases; source object arguments use stable identity tokens
Actor/effect/view lifecycle remains outside this callback-only adapter
